Measured 5.0 x 4.0 x 5.1 m (kit scale, source_scale 1.0) against the prompt's 4 m deep, 4 m rise; the 'square posts' are the tall top ends of the side walls.

The colour assertions measure the whole shared atlas and the lift-only correction can't darken the kit's lighter greys; the user decides between measuring colour over UV-covered texels, allowing darkening for sourced kits, recolouring the atlas, or accepting kit colours.
